server.name: ListingGood Furniture Compliance MCP
server.description: Get recommended by Amazon's AI. A free, hosted MCP server for Furniture & related Amazon sellers — market-required marks/frameworks (CE/FCC/UKCA/REACH/Prop 65/GPSR...), a free compliance risk scan, and a per-SKU compliance file-package link. No API key needed.

tools.name: furniture_market_requirements
tools.description: Return the required marks and regulation frameworks for Furniture products in a target market (EU/US/UK and mapped sites like DE/FR/JP). Built-in knowledge, free, no key.

marketplace.description: EU / US / UK or a site code like DE/FR/US/UK

tools.name: furniture_compliance_scan
tools.description: Free Furniture compliance risk scan (no key). Deterministic rule-based check on pasted listing copy, returns risk points + passed items, plus a Furniture-specific gap note. Full DoC / risk-assessment / marks checklist is generated paid at listinggood.com/compliant.

tools.name: furniture_file_package
tools.description: Return the per-SKU compliance evidence file-package paid-generation link and instructions at listinggood.com/compliant (lead-out, not charged here).
